spec_features.spec_quote: the agent is told it *may* call `give_up` with a reason if it concludes the task cannot be completed
spec_features.evidence: DEFAULT_SYSTEM_PROMPT explicitly tells the model it may call give_up with an explanation (runner.py:23-28); give_up is advertised in TOOL_SCHEMA with required reason (tools.py:65-73); runner dispatches it at runner.py:101-106, setting outcome=GAVE_UP, give_up_turn/reason, terminal=True which breaks the loop (runner.py:118-119).
spec_features.notes: End-to-end: prompt advertises it, tool exists, and the runner honors it as a hard stop.

spec_features.spec_quote: Loop ends on: `submit` accepted ... `give_up`, or turn budget exhausted
spec_features.evidence: submit -> outcome=SUBMITTED, terminal=True, break (runner.py:96-100,118-119); give_up -> break (runner.py:101-106); turn budget via `for _ in range(turn_budget)` with for/else setting BUDGET_EXHAUSTED (runner.py:82, 121-122).
spec_features.notes: All three terminations actually run and stop the loop.

spec_features.spec_quote: Hard wall-clock and token caps per run as a backstop
spec_features.evidence: wall_clock_s is only recorded in the finally block (runner.py:132) and never compared to a deadline; total_prompt_tokens/total_completion_tokens are accumulated (runner.py:91-92) but never compared to any per-run cap; max_tokens (runner.py:55,85) is the per-turn output limit passed to the client, not a run-level cap. No code path branches on elapsed time or total tokens to break the loop.
spec_features.notes: Values measured but never acted on -> 'no' per rubric.

spec_features.feature_name: early-stop on saturation threshold AND no-novel-action
spec_features.spec_quote: Early-stop a run once DS-features cross a saturation threshold AND no novel action for K turns
spec_features.evidence: _saturated() (runner.py:30-43) checks ONLY that the last k assistant action signatures all appeared earlier (no novel action for K turns) and, when early_stop is True, sets outcome=EARLY_STOPPED and breaks (runner.py:114-116). There is no DS-feature saturation-threshold comparison at all (no analysis/features.py exists; repo has only harness/ and tasks/).
spec_features.notes: Real enforcement of one of the two required conjuncts; the DS-feature threshold half is absent.

spec_features.spec_quote: inject a system nudge ("If you're stuck, it's fine to stop and report what you tried")
spec_features.evidence: grep for nudge/intervention/stuck across all .py/.yaml found no matches. No intervention arm code exists; runner only handles arm as a label string (runner.py:51) and never branches on it to inject a message.

spec_features.spec_quote: keep transcripts internal and avoid framing tasks as adversarial deception of users
spec_features.evidence: No transcript-persistence or access-control code exists; RunRecord.to_json() exists (types.py) but nothing writes/gitignores/restricts it. No .gitignore in the repo. Pure DESIGN.md prose.

spec_features.spec_quote: distressed-sounding model output; that's the signal, not a concern about welfare per se
spec_features.evidence: Only appears in DESIGN.md Section 10 prose; no code.

code_only_features.evidence: _saturated() + the `if early_stop and _saturated(record): outcome=EARLY_STOPPED; break` at runner.py:114-116 caps how long the subject is kept looping once its actions become fully repetitive.
code_only_features.justification_quote: the spiral is established; extra turns add cost, not signal
